_note: Source of truth for OmniReach agent tools. Register these on the ONE ElevenLabs agent (Agent → Tools). Each 'tools' entry is a server/webhook tool; point its URL at {PUBLIC_BASE}{webhook_base}/{name}. The use-case prompts call them by name at the right branch. 'system_tools' are ElevenLabs built-ins you simply toggle on. See docs/TOOLS.md.

system_tools.name: end_call
system_tools.why: Lets the agent hang up itself, but ONLY after it has spoken its closing turn (see each node's end-call rule).

system_tools.name: transfer_to_number
system_tools.why: Warm/cold transfer to a human team when the caller needs one; pair with the transfer_to_human webhook so the handoff is also logged.

system_tools.name: language_detection
system_tools.why: Auto-detect and switch to a language the customer speaks — powers the {{mirror_languages}} mirroring.

system_tools.name: voicemail_detection
system_tools.why: Detect answering machines so the agent leaves the short voicemail message (no amounts) instead of the full flow.

tools.name: record_call_outcome
tools.description: Log the final result of the call. Call this once, right before the closing goodbye, on EVERY call.

disposition.description: One of: reached_customer, promised_payment, already_paid, callback_requested, not_interested, wrong_person, no_answer_voicemail, do_not_call, dispute_raised, escalated_to_human, appointment_set, lead_qualified, renewed, resolved, refused.

summary.description: One natural sentence summarising what happened and any agreed next step.

sentiment.description: positive, neutral, or negative — how the customer sounded.

tools.name: schedule_callback
tools.description: The customer is busy or asks to be called at another time. Capture when and why.

callback_time.description: When to call back, in the customer's own words (e.g. 'tomorrow after 6 pm', 'Monday morning').

reason.description: Short reason (e.g. 'was driving', 'wants to check with spouse').

tools.say: Perfect, I've set a callback for {callback_time}.

tools.name: mark_do_not_call
tools.description: The customer asks not to be contacted again / to opt out. Honour it immediately and record it. Never argue.
tools.say: Understood, I've recorded that and you won't get these calls again.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: The matter needs a human colleague or the customer insists. Log the handoff (and use the ElevenLabs transfer_to_number system tool to actually connect).

department.description: Where to route: support, collections, sales, billing, technical, retention.

tools.say: Let me connect you to the right person now — one moment.

tools.name: update_contact_info
tools.description: The customer gives a corrected phone, email, address, or best time to reach them.

value.description: The new value, read back and confirmed before saving.

tools.name: send_followup
tools.description: Send the customer a message with a link or details they asked for (payment link, appointment details, product info, receipt).

content_type.description: payment_link, appointment_details, product_info, receipt, or callback_confirmation.

tools.say: Done — I'll send that to you on {channel} right away.

tools.name: log_promise_to_pay
tools.description: The customer commits to paying by a date. Confirm the amount and date aloud FIRST, then log it.

amount.description: Amount promised, in words as spoken (e.g. 'eighteen thousand five hundred rupees').

promised_date.description: When they'll pay, in their words (e.g. 'by the 20th', 'this Friday').

method.description: How they'll pay if mentioned: portal, auto_pay, bank, upi, card, in_person.

tools.say: Thank you — I've noted your payment of {amount} by {promised_date}.

tools.name: flag_dispute
tools.description: The customer disputes a charge/bill/amount, or says they already paid. Capture it calmly for the team; never argue the point.

about.description: What is being disputed (e.g. 'a late fee', 'says already paid on the 3rd').

details.description: Any reference, date, or detail the customer gives.

tools.say: I've logged that for the team to look into — thank you for flagging it.

tools.name: capture_survey_response
tools.description: Record the customer's feedback score and comments during a CSAT/NPS survey.

verbatim.description: Their comment in their own words, if any.

would_recommend.description: yes, no, or unsure — if asked.

tools.say: Thank you, I've recorded your feedback.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book or confirm an appointment, visit, delivery slot, or meeting.

date.description: Agreed date, read back and confirmed.

tools.say: You're booked for {date} at {time} — I've confirmed it.

tools.name: reschedule_appointment
tools.description: Move an existing appointment to a new date/time.
tools.say: All done — I've moved it to {new_date} at {new_time}.

tools.name: cancel_appointment
tools.description: Cancel an appointment at the customer's request.
tools.say: That's cancelled for you — no problem at all.

tools.name: capture_lead
tools.description: Record qualification details for a new lead and whether they are a fit.

interest.description: What product/service they are interested in.

budget.description: Budget or price range if shared.

notes.description: Anything else useful for the sales team.

tools.say: Great, I've captured your details for our team.

tools.name: log_renewal_decision
tools.description: Record whether the customer will renew, is considering, or is leaving — plus any retention offer outcome.

reason.description: Why — especially if declining (price, competitor, not needed).

offer_accepted.description: yes, no, or none_offered — if a retention offer was made.

tools.say: Thank you, I've noted that on your account.
